member.name: P:Asp.Versioning.ApiExplorer.ApiExplorerOptions.AddApiVersionParametersWhenVersionNeutral
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether API version parameters are added when an API is version-neutral.
member.value: True if API version parameters should be included when exploring a version-neutral API; otherwise, false. The default value is false.

remarks.para: A version-neutral API can accept any API version, including none at all. Setting this property to true will enable exploring parameter descriptors for an API version that can be used to generate user input, which may be useful for a version-neutral API that its own per-API version logic.
An API version defined using the URL segment method is unaffected by this setting because path-based route parameters are always required.
